stem: How does the author's use of language in this sentence contribute to the tone of the selection?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 3.

_PB began in the 1980s and is now used in over 3,000 cities worldwide._

options.label: A
options.text: By providing a fact and a statistic, it creates an informative tone.

options.label: B
options.text: By sharing a detailed description, it creates a convincing tone.

options.label: C
options.text: By highlighting the history of the topic, it creates a serious tone.

options.label: D
options.text: By including a number and a date, it creates a positive tone.
